objective: Create the safe PC cleanup audit package. This is design and inventory tooling only: no deletion, no local execution, no paid services. Define a structured audit schema, a discovery procedure, a read-only PowerShell inventory script that can later be run manually on Windows, and an Astra review packet. Update project memory/provenance. The audit script must never delete, uninstall, modify registry, stop services, or alter files.
constraints: No AI video inference on local PC
No cleanup deletion or uninstall actions
PowerShell script must be read-only and output an inventory report only
acceptance_criteria: ActiveProjectRoot missing or file-valued fails clearly.
Missing/file-valued/unreadable candidate roots or enumeration errors cannot produce an apparently successful complete report.
Active protection applies only to paths actually inside ActiveProjectRoot.
External worker_result_*.json and external .github paths are not KEEP_ACTIVE merely because of their names.
provenance_match is exact normalized absolute path membership only.
External exact provenance match -> CANDIDATE_REVIEW_ONLY; external no match -> UNVERIFIED_DO_NOT_REMOVE.
Each item has required size, UTC mtime, provenance/evidence/recommendation/reason fields and schema enums them.
Duplicate/overlapping roots emit each file once.
OutputPath is atomic create-new; existing destination remains unchanged; default stdout creates no file.
CURRENT_STATE records Google Drive and configured Gemini GitHub secret without exposing secret material; NEXT_ACTIONS removes completed manual steps.
Review packet stays pending and contains planned regression evidence metadata without fabricating pass results.
